title: ChannelConfig
description: A channel's full config document, stored in channels.config, edited on the Channels screen. Per-video overrides deep-merge at enqueue (chain lists replace wholesale) into the immutable cfg.json snapshot.

model.description: provider model id; the agents already read it

prompt.description: prompt pack name (contracts/prompts/script/<name>.json) — layer 2 of the D44 resolution order

model.description: provider model id; the agents already read it

chunk_target_beats.description: above this many target beats the script is planned in sentence-aligned CHUNKS, one call each, instead of one call for the whole video. A single call handles ~20-30 beats comfortably; past that it truncates or degrades, and one dropped sentence fails full coverage for the entire sheet.

spine.description: phase 1 of this agent on a chunked script: one cheap call that finds where the story TURNS, so sections are cut at joints instead of at even word counts. It shares planner.llm/model — it is the same bounded agent (D2), not a fourth one.

enabled.description: false uses the deterministic word-balanced split, which is also what a failed or malformed spine degrades to

chat.description: editor chat agent (D15); the platform reads it from the video's cfg snapshot

content_rules.description: channel content rules text, given to the planner

chain.description: order = preference; omission = forbidden; replaced wholesale by overrides

dedup.description: D54 — how hard this channel works to avoid showing the same thing twice in one video. Per-beat resolution is independent by design, which is what lets two adjacent beats about the same subject fetch the same clip.

reuse_window_items.description: how many recent visual items an exact asset id stays blocked for. 0 = the whole video: a segment is spent once. A small number suits a channel with a thin library, where a callback after four minutes reads as a motif rather than as a mistake.

min_hamming_distance.description: near-duplicate threshold on a 64-bit perceptual hash of one frame: a candidate closer than this to a shot already used is skipped. 0 = off (the default, since the check costs one wasted download per repeat); ~6 catches the same footage re-encoded or re-graded, without catching two different shots of the same subject.

sound_pack.description: sound pack name; overrides theme.sound.pack. The pack manifest is embedded as sound_pack_doc at enqueue.

enabled.description: master switch for background music on this channel; false makes the resolve_audio stage a no-op for beds

default_volume.description: D48: a TRIM on the theme's music levels, not the level itself — 1 means 'as the theme mixed it', 0.5 pulls music down 6 dB across the channel. The absolute levels are theme.sound.gain.music_duck / music_lift, so the mix lives in one place.

enabled.description: master switch for sound effects on this channel; overridable per video like any config field

overrides.description: per-video override slot (style pack fields like overlay density ride here in the snapshot)

style_pack_doc.description: full style pack document embedded at enqueue (snapshot, Core Principle 7)

theme_doc.description: full theme document embedded at enqueue (snapshot)

sound_pack_doc.description: full sound pack manifest embedded at enqueue (snapshot). Absent when no pack is resolved, which is how a channel produces silent video.

prompts.description: resolved prompt TEXT per role, embedded at enqueue (D44). Editing a prompt afterwards never changes this video; a re-run reproduces the same words.

source.description: which layer of the D44 ladder won

system.description: editable half only; the welded block is appended at call time

style.description: ai_image style suffix appended to the visual_intent
